description: Canonical, engine-independent Governor (Sector Tile) data for Mercurio. Single source of truth for renderers.

governors.name: Industrial Symbiosis
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has planets with Ore and Robot outputs.

governors.name: Life Support Loop
governors.description: Score 2 VP if sector has planets with Water and Population outputs.

governors.name: Synthetic Exchange
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has planets with Electronics and Robots outputs.

governors.name: Bio-Processing Ring
governors.description: Score 2 VP if sector has planets with Algae, Water and Grain outputs.

governors.name: Extraction Corridor
governors.description: Score 2 VP if sector has at least 2 planets and 1 project.

governors.name: Civil-Military Complex
governors.description: Score 2 VP if sector has planets with Population and Robot outputs.

governors.name: Tri-Specialization Hub
governors.description: Score 2 VP if sector produces at least 3 different outputs.

governors.name: Vertical Integration
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has planets with Crates & Electronics outputs.

governors.name: Sector Megacity
governors.description: Score 3 VP if a sector is fully occupied (5 planets).

governors.name: Self-Sufficient Sector
governors.description: Score 3 VP if 3 planets in the sector have all inputs satisfied.

governors.name: Mono-Output Array
governors.description: Score 3 VP if outputs of 3 planets are fully consumed.

governors.name: Diverse Economic Zone
governors.description: Score 4 VP if the sector has 5 different outputs.

governors.name: Industrial Wastes
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has Forge + Scrap planets.

governors.name: Salvage Loop
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has 2 Scrap planets and 1 Project.

governors.name: Manufacturing Spine
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Forge + Scrap planets and Electronics output.

governors.name: Proto-Development Zone
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has 2 Proto planets.

governors.name: Emergent Biosphere
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Proto + Jungle + Swamp planets.

governors.name: Terraforming Cluster
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Earth + Jungle + Ocean planets.

governors.name: Oceanic Network
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has 2 Ocean planets.

governors.name: Cold Chain Logistics
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has Cold + Ice planets and a project.

governors.name: Environmental Contrast
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has Cold + Jungle planets.

governors.name: Planetary Melting Pot
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has 4 planets of different types.

governors.name: Wetland Exploitation
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has Swamp + Jungle planets and Water output.

governors.name: Polar Research Sector
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Ice + Proto planets and Robots input.

governors.name: Frozen Industrial Zone
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Forge + Cold + Ice planets.

governors.name: Harsh Frontier
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Cold + Scrap + Proto planets.

governors.name: Deep Freeze Network
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has 2 Ice planets.

governors.name: Ecological Pressure Zone
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Swamp + Jungle + Cold planets.

governors.name: Overdeveloped Sector
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has 4 planets and at least 2 Projects.

governors.name: Fragmented Biosphere
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has 3 different planets among Earth/Jungle/Swamp/Ocean.

governors.name: Industrial Overlap
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has 2 Forge + 1 Scrap planets.

governors.name: Mixed Climate Corridor
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector has Ice + Ocean + Earth planets.

governors.name: Resource Bottleneck
governors.description: Score 3 VP if 2 planets in this sector require the same input good.

governors.name: Redundant Infrastructure
governors.description: Score 3 VP if 2 planets produce the same output.

governors.name: Settlement Density
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has at least 3 planets and no Projects.

governors.name: Industrial–Biological Interface
governors.description: Score 4 VP if sector Forge, Swamp and Jungle planets.

governors.name: Harsh Coexistence
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has Cold or Ice planets and Water or Algae as outputs.

governors.name: Sector Specialization
governors.description: Score 4 VP if all planets have 1 specific basic good as either output or input.

governors.name: Input Convergence
governors.description: Score 2 VP if 2 planets have 1 specific basic good as either output or input.

governors.name: Climate Crossroads
governors.description: Score 3 VP if sector has at least 1 Cold or Ice planet and 2 bio planets (Earth/Jungle/Swamp/Ocean).
